# DOM selection repair must set the actual selectionEnd property

The address-widget test corrects uppercase SelectionEnd to selectionEnd and sets it beside selectionStart before typing into both ordinary and pill inputs. It directly checks z+key. The later synthesis/frame details differ at the fixed revision. Valid property spelling repairs the caret setup; the author remains unsure it cured the intermittent and a post-landing failure is recorded. This is an exact DOM API contract, not a general casing rule.

Scope: Compose selection tests.
